title: Towards Pareto-Optimal Tool-Integrated Agents with Pareto Ranking Policy Optimization

layout.note: One plot-shaped drawing: a tick-less accuracy-efficiency plane fills the figure, a legend box sits inside its top-right corner, stage titles at the top left and middle right, and curves, paths and labels lie over a gradient ground.

lesson: Explain a multi-stage optimiser on one illustrative objective plane: draw the target set (frontier), what the baseline can reach (convex hull) and each stage as a differently coloured path that starts where the previous one ends, with tinted pointers beside the stage titles.
